title: SMaRT–PDM
description: Scholarship management and records tracking for PDM.
summary: A web and Android scholarship management platform for OSFA at Pambayang Dalubhasaan ng Marilao, featuring applications, student monitoring, community service, payouts, role-based portals and reporting.

title: Song Painter
description: Turn an uploaded song into a visual artwork.
summary: A creative audio-visual studio where uploaded local music drives a painting canvas. It includes playback, adjustable visual controls and an artwork export flow.

title: Budget Tracker
description: A simple personal income and expense tracker.
summary: A lightweight browser-based budget tracker for recording income and expenses, showing current totals, deleting transactions and switching between light and dark themes. Data is saved locally in the browser.

title: WeLead
description: A project and client management platform for coordinating work, inquiries, and consultations.
summary: WeLead is a web-based management platform with user authentication, role-restricted administrator and member areas, project planning and tracking, client inquiry review, portfolio gallery management, and consultation scheduling. Its interface brings project workflows and client-facing operations together in one place.
